text:
Aisha CSM: FYI — Northstar dedicated bring-up is locked for Tue 08:00 PST. Need final quota runway, autoscale policy, and a short load test window. Renewal in ~90d so want clean onboarding.
Brent SE: Got it. Do we have their expected sustained vs peak RPS and avg token lengths?
Aisha CSM: Northstar provided a traffic profile yesterday: sustained ~150rps, peak bursts to 1.2k for ~5-10m. Payloads avg ~120 tokens.
Lina SRE: Those bursts are the pain point. Recommend quota runway = 4x sustained, with headroom policy to allow 1.5k bursts for 15m before fallback. Also suggest warmup priming KV caches.
Samir Eng: I can run a load test Wed 02:00 PST. Do we want shadow traffic first or direct?
Aisha CSM: Start with shadow for 30m, then a short routed soak for 10m if shadows look clean. Capture tail latency percentiles and error rates.
Brent SE: Autoscale draft: min_replicas=2, scale_target_requests_per_sec=200, step_scale=+2, cooldown=60s, burst_policy=temporary_burst(15m)->route-to-fallback. Will post JSON.
Devon PM: Also need enablement for Northstar's infra team — 30m walkthrough of dashboards and runbook. Can we do Tue 11:00 PST?
Aisha CSM: Tue 11 works for me. Invite customer leads + their infra eng. I'll send calendar.
Samir Eng: Load script snippet I'll use: ```vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=200 -duration=30m | vegeta report -type=json > northstar-shadow.json``` targets file will contain a ramp pattern to reproduce peaks.
Lina SRE: Add KV-warmup step: run small prefix requests to populate cache before vegeta main run. Example: ```for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"seed $i"}'; done```
loadbot: loadtest-scheduler: scheduled vegeta job (id: lt-2024-17156) for 1715673600 (Wed 02:00 PST).
Brent SE: Quick checklist for test metrics — p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, model token consumption, cost per 1k tokens, cache hit ratio.
Aisha CSM: Also track request routing: confirm if any requests drop to fallback model and note quality diffs.
Devon PM: Renewal risk note: if we see >1% 5xx or repeated fallbacks during peak sim, flag as "High" and schedule remediation before renewal review.
Samir Eng: Will upload test artifacts + slack thread logs to customer-case: NS-453 and mark follow-ups.
Lina SRE: On autoscale rollout plan — canary at 10% traffic for 1h, then 50% for 2h, then 100%. If error delta >0.5% between canary and baseline -> rollback.
Aisha CSM: Perfect. Action items: Samir run shadow Wed 02, Brent post autoscale JSON and policy, Lina prepare warmup script, Devon send enablement invite, Aisha to share renewal risk playbook.
Brent SE: Posted autoscale JSON here: ```{ "min":2, "target_rps":200, "burst_window_mins":15, "burst_headroom":1500 }``` :thumbsup:
Aisha CSM: Thanks all — I'll follow up with Northstar after the shadow run. If anything is unstable, ping #eng-oncall immediately.
Samir Eng: noted, will tag @Lina and @Brent during the run.
loadbot: run-complete: lt-2024-17156 -> status: shadow_ok, p95: 210ms, p99: 520ms, 5xx: 0.2% (artifacts: /s3/ns-453/lt-2024-17156).
Aisha CSM: Results look good at shadow. Scheduling routed soak at Wed 03:00 PST per plan.
Devon PM: Sending enablement invite now.
Lina SRE: I'll keep an eye on KV hit rates during the routed soak. If hit ratio drops <70% we throttle priming.
Aisha CSM: Thanks team. Closing this thread after routed soak and artifact upload.
